items.text: It is "does this door read my result, and for how long".
IISER takes IAT only, and IISc BS takes JEE Advanced or IAT.

blocks.heading: How Long Your JEE Result Stays Useful

items.text: A JEE result is not a permanent pass.
JoSAA 2026 was expected to finish around 20 July 2026.
The counselling date comes from a coaching site.

blocks.heading: JEE But Still Give You a B.tech

items.text: The Navy and Army cadet entries use a JEE Main result, so they show up in every "after JEE" list.
You enter as a naval cadet through JEE Main rank and SSB.
Best for: students who want the uniform more than the B.Tech label.
The same ledger gives three different plans, depending on what you hold today.
Your 2026 JEE Main or Advanced result opened its doors in the 2026 cycle.
Best for: a drop year spent on one new test, plus one proof asset.

blocks.heading: Four Questions Before You Pick a Door

items.text: Before you commit, check your fit, your situation, the job market and AI-proofing.
Can you hold a pencil and a design for hours, wait years on a research ladder, run to a whistle, or live months at sea.
A rank you are proud of does not decide your daily work.

blocks.heading: Headroom, and What Caps the Rest

items.text: Several doors here have two hard filters: getting in, then the first strong placement, licence or rank.
UCEED, NID, a CUET BSc and the IIT Madras BS all lead to work you can show before you graduate: a portfolio, a dataset, a shipped tool.
Best for: students who will build visible work every week.
A high-value skill portfolio is one core skill, one multiplier skill and finished proof that someone else can check.
Architecture and planning
What JEE prep already gave you: The Maths and Physics you drilled for JEE.
